test_title: PYST 33: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the ANTONYM of the word "INADVERTENT" to fill in the blank.**

Everyone likes to speak in a clear and ________ manner.
solution: The correct answer is: **Deliberate**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Inadvertent **means unintentional or accidental. (अनजाने या आकस्मिक) • **Example**: *The spill was inadvertent, occurring unexpectedly during routine maintenance.* • Marked option **Deliberate **is the opposite of inadvertent, meaning intentional or on purpose. (जानबूझकर) • **Example**: *His actions were deliberate, carefully planned to achieve a specific outcome.* • Clear and deliberate manner means speaking with intention and purpose, making sure that what is being said is clear and easily understood. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Unintentional **means not done on purpose. (जानबूझकर नहीं किया गया) • **Peevish **means easily irritated or annoyed. (आसानी से चिढ़ जाना या परेशान होना) • **Impious **means lacking respect or showing disrespect for something sacred. (किसी पवित्र चीज़ के प्रति सम्मान की कमी या अनादर दिखाना) 36:Ta97, The correct answer is: **Taller**
